capabilities: Create regular and exchange transactions in notes
Autosuggest account names from an accounts file
Automatically calculate balances for transaction entries
Organize transactions in daily notes with a dedicated section
Export and import transactions between daily notes and journal files
extras: Transactions are stored in daily notes, so users must already follow a daily notes workflow with a configurable filename date format.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record or manage hledger accounting transactions alongside your notes.
summary: Plain-text accounting plugin that creates, edits, and organizes hledger transactions in daily notes and syncs them with hledger journal files.
